lifePath: As a life path, this shadow tends to repeat across years more than days. You may meet it at each new start, job or home, as a pattern that returns until something changes in how you handle it.
expression: As an expression number, this shadow shows in how you work. It tends to appear in your style, in how you take other people's input, and in how you finish things.
soulUrge: As a soul urge, this shadow is quiet. It sits under your choices as a want or a fear you may not name, and it often shows in what you avoid more than in what you do.
personality: As a personality number, this shadow is what people tend to notice first. It may be a manner, a tone or a way of holding yourself that does not match what is going on inside.
birthDay: As a birth day, this shadow is a small habit more than a theme. It tends to appear as a knack overused, a reflex you reach for when you are tired or hurried.
maturity: As a maturity number, this shadow is one to meet later in life. It may stay quiet for decades and then ask for attention once other roles have settled.
